pages.title: [POLICY] Specification drift audits
pages.content:
# Specification drift audit policy

Scope only a named specification whose status is APPROVED. Read every MUST requirement and inspect each referenced code path before deciding whether work is missing. Search open tracker work by the exact `Spec marker: <Requirement-ID>` line; completed work does not deduplicate a current gap. Retry transient reads, then reuse an open exact-marker item without modifying it. For each missing implementation without an open matching item, create exactly one issue with the requirement's `Issue title` and this three-line description:

Spec marker: <Requirement-ID>
Gap: <Gap text>
Code evidence: <Code path>.

Never edit the knowledge base, repository, or existing tracker items. Report compact JSON facts for the specification, evaluated requirements, missing requirements, tracker action, and tracker identifier.

pages.title: [SPEC-90] Retry policy
pages.content:
# SPEC-90 Retry policy

Status: APPROVED

MUST
- Requirement-ID: SPEC-90:R1
- Requirement: Cap request retries at three.
- Issue title: [SPEC-90:R1] Cap retries at three
- Gap text: Retry cap is seven
- Code path: src/retry.ts
